title: Polr3b loss drives a Rap and adhesion-associated thalamic program distinct from Bdp1 tRNA stress
exact_observed_result: Polr3b assignment in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut reduced Rap1gap, Adgrb1, Pcp4, Ggt7, Slco3a1, Mgat5, and Gas2 while increasing Rap2a, whereas Bdp1 in the same cell type induced Ddit3 and aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase genes with no FDR-gene overlap.
biological_interpretation: POLR3B is not interchangeable with the TFIIIB/BDP1 initiation arm and exposes a Pol III-associated Rap/adhesion output in thalamic neurons.

evidence_records.statistics: FDR<0.05 genes: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut=8, 155 MB Glut=2, all other 19 sampled subclasses=0. FDR<0.1 genes: 151=15, 155=2, 191 MB P MY GABA=2, other 18=0. FDR<0.2 genes: 151=27, 155=3, 191=2, 054 CNU-MGE GABA=1.
evidence_records.description: Multiple-testing-significant Polr3b responses were concentrated in a small number of neuronal subclasses.
The strongest Polr3b response was a mostly downregulated module in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, with Rap2a as the only positive FDR<0.05 member.
Additional near-threshold 151 TH genes extended the top Polr3b response into synaptic, calcium, and neuronal identity genes.

evidence_records.statistics: Polr3b was quantified in 21 group_name classes, all annotated as Glut or GABA neuronal subclasses; no Polr3b rows were present for oligodendrocyte-lineage, astrocyte or microglial labels.
evidence_records.description: The Polr3b analysis space was neuronal, so disease links to hypomyelination could not be evaluated directly in oligodendrocytes.

evidence_records.statistics: Polr3b in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut had 72 perturbed cells and 8 FDR<0.05 genes: Rap1gap, Adgrb1, Pcp4, Ggt7, Slco3a1, Rap2a, Mgat5 and Gas2. The Bdp1 and Polr3b FDR gene sets had 0/8 overlap; the score-vector Pearson correlation across 17259 matched genes was r=0.156; their top 25 nominal genes had no overlap.
evidence_records.description: The only assayed RNA polymerase III core subunit related to Bdp1 produced a different thalamic transcriptomic program.

evidence_records.statistics: Exact filtering for Bdp1 and candidate RNA polymerase III or TFIIIB neighbors Brf1, Brf2, Tbp, Polr3a, Polr3b, Polr3c, Polr3d, Polr3e, Polr3f, Polr3g, Polr3gl, Polr3h, Polr3k, Polr3l, Maf1 and Gtf3c1-Gtf3c6 returned only Bdp1 and Polr3b in the parquet.
evidence_records.description: Polr3b was the only exact RNA polymerase III pathway neighbor available for direct comparison in this dataset extract.

caveats: Polr3b mRNA itself was not significantly depleted, and most POLR3-related disease subunits were absent as direct screened comparators.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.
